Components / States

Message block

.dr-msg · __title · __body · __actions · .dr-mark · --warn · --danger · components/message.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Withdrawal didn't go through

The transfer to your card failed and the ₴1,500 is back in your balance. Check the card details, or try a bank transfer instead.

Try again Use bank transfer
  1. 1.dr-msgThe block: --card at the 16 radius, padding 22 / 18, gap 12, centred, no shadow.
  2. 2.dr-markThe state mark: 52 × 52 at the 13 media radius, 26px glyph, aria-hidden.
  3. 3.dr-msg__titleWhat happened, at the title step 17/600, line 1.4.
  4. 4.dr-msg__bodyWhat it means for the user, 13/400 at line 1.5 in slate, capped at 260px.
  5. 5.dr-msg__actionsThe way out: full-width buttons stacked with gap 10, 6 below the body, primary on top.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: Message block; Empty-state banner.

States

No state of its own: nothing in the block takes focus but its buttons. They take the button states.

When to use

One component doing three jobs: the empty state, the error and the notice. It stands on 32 screen files, every one an -empty or -error state, from listings-error to withdraw-error; the 33rd, order-history-empty, carries the banner message. No empty or error screen is a dead end. On 25 of the 32 the exits sit in the block's own __actions; on the other 7 (contact-support-error, onboarding-client-empty, operator-signup-error, operator-verification-error, payment-error, report-issue-empty, signin-error) the block ends on its body and the exits stand in the screen's action bar. The state is told by the mark's glyph and the title, with the wash as a second carrier, never by colour alone.

The screens build the title two ways: a span in 25 files and a p in 7 (order-confirmed-error, tracking-empty, tracking-error, tracking-aerial-empty, tracking-aerial-error, tracking-inspection-empty, tracking-inspection-error). The body is a p and the actions a div everywhere. The live role is alert on 15 blocks and status on 12; five carry none (onboarding-client-empty, tracking-empty, tracking-aerial-empty, tracking-inspection-empty, wallet-empty).

The copy follows voice.md's state tone. Empty: why it is empty, then one way out. Error: what happened, what it means for the user's order or money, and what to do, with no apology and no joke. The verbs are fixed: Try again to recover, Contact support to reach a person. No Oops, no exclamation marks.

Sources: DESIGN.md § Message block · § State marks · voice.md § Microcopy (Empty state, Error) · P5 · inventory.md § 1.3

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Live tracking lost

We've lost the live signal from the operator's device. Your order is still active.

Try again Contact support

tracking-error: the fact, what it costs (nothing; the order is still active) and two exits. It stays on screen until the user acts, which is why an error lives here and not in a toast.

Don’t

Delivered

Your parcel arrived at 10:07.

Rate this order

A success drawn as a message block. Success is a screen of its own, with the milestone well and the display title: use the outcome. For a confirmation of an action that leaves no other trace, use a toast.
